outputs.calibration.json: per-recording parameter set with provenance per parameter

yaw_deg.source: lane vanishing point, 976 segments over 59 straight frames (half-split spread 0.20 deg)

pitch_deg.source: FOE at (797,464) px, 425093 flow vectors, inliers=0.86

lateral_offset_m.source: ego-lane centre vs camera over 59 frames (lane width 3.60 m)
lateral_offset_m.note: +left. Assumes lane-centred driving on average over the session.

mount_longitudinal_m.note: +forward. Phone position ahead of the vehicle reference point (rear axle). The exported trajectory is the rear axle's path, not the phone's: a point mounted this far forward swings wide through every turn, and ignoring it left up to 2.6 m of lateral error at intersections while straight-road checks still showed centimetres.

trajectory_reference.source: phone re-referenced by (L=2.10, W=+0.25) m via a per-point rigid transform

cross_checks.plane_height_rejected: only 14 homographies; pitch disagrees with the FOE by 4.8 deg; height spread +/-0.56 m

stats.unit_notes: accel: derived: total_accel - gravity [m/s^2, linear]; gravity: Gravity.csv [m/s^2]; total_accel: TotalAcceleration.csv [m/s^2]
